product_name: FC1800T台式爆炸物毒品探测仪
summary: FC1800T 台式爆炸物毒品探测仪采用行业领先的真空紫外光电离源（VUV）技术，不含任何放射性物质，使用安全且维护便捷。该设备具备正、负双模式检测能力，能同时分析并识别纳克级的爆炸物与毒品成分。配备 10.4 寸高清彩色触摸屏与中文操作界面，支持声光及隐藏式报警模式。系统内置海量开放式数据库，可实时存储超 10 万条记录，支持云端更新，是机场、海关及重要场馆安全检查的理想选择。
summary_en: The FC1800T Desktop Explosives and Narcotics Detector utilizes industry-leading vacuum ultraviolet (VUV) photoionization technology, which is non-radioactive, making it safer to use and easier to maintain. The device features simultaneous positive and negative dual-mode detection, allowing it to analyze and identify nanogram-level explosive and narcotic components concurrently. Equipped with a 10.4-inch HD color touchscreen and a Chinese interface, it supports various alarm modes including acoustic, visual, and discrete alerts. With an open database capable of storing over 100,000 records and supporting cloud updates, it is an ideal choice for high-security environments such as airports, customs, and critical venues.
key_application: 应用领域：FC1800T台式爆炸物毒品探测仪；设计安全：不含放射性源真空紫外光电离源，使用更安全、方便，能同时准备分析爆炸物和毒品成份；
key_application_en: Simultaneous trace detection of explosives and narcotics; non-radioactive vacuum UV light source; 6-second ultra-fast analysis; 10.4-inch touchscreen with 100,000+ data storage capability.
key_parameter_1: 外观尺寸: 380 mm(W)×400 mm(L)×180 mm(H)

parameters.采用技术: 真空紫外光电离源 (VUV) - 无放射性源
parameters.可检爆炸物: 黑火药、硝酸铵、TNT、HMX、RDX、PETN、NG等各类军用/民用炸药
parameters.可检毒品: 可卡因、海洛因、大麻、冰毒、K粉、吗啡等
parameters.操作系统: 10.4寸 TFT 彩色触摸屏，全中文界面
parameters.取样方式: 痕量颗粒试纸擦拭取样
parameters.存储容量: 不少于 100,000 条数据，支持检索/导出
parameters.网络支持: 有线网络 (LAN)、无线 (WiFi)、蓝牙及 USB

parameters_en.Explosives Library: Black Powder, AN, TNT, HMX, DNT, Tetryl, PETN, RDX, NG, and various improvised explosives
parameters_en.Narcotics Library: Cocaine, Heroin, Marijuana, Methamphetamine, Ketamine, Morphine, etc.
parameters_en.Sampling Method: Trace particle swiping via test paper
parameters_en.Storage: ≥ 100,000 records; support for retrieval and cloud updates

detail_html:
功能特点

  • 核级安全保障：采用非放射性VUV电离技术，无准用证申请限制，保障操作员绝对安全。
  • 察打一体：正负双离子迁移模式切换，一次采样即可同时筛查毒品与爆炸物。
  • 纳克级精准识别：特别优化了对黑火药及土制化学炸弹的检测算法，有效杜绝漏报。
  • 极速分析吞吐量：全程分析仅需6秒，配合快速清洗功能（≤6s），适应高频次安检。
  • 海量情报管理：内置开放式数据库，支持实时添加新样本，海量存储10万条以上检测记录。
  • 人性化交互：10.4寸大屏图文显示分析谱图，提供柱状条形图展示，支持多通道报警输出。
  • Figure 1 Desktop Explosives & Narcotics Detector
detail_html_en:
Features

  • Radiation-Free Safety: utilizes vacuum ultraviolet (VUV) ionization, eliminating the need for complex radioactive source permits and ensuring long-term user health.
  • Dual-Path Detection: simultaneous positive and negative ion analysis enables one-step screening for both narcotics and explosives.
  • Nanogram Sensitivity: identifies trace particles of Black Powder and standard military explosives (TNT, RDX) with high fidelity.
  • High-Efficiency Throughput: features a sub-6-second analysis cycle with a rapid self-cleaning mechanism for continuous screening missions.
  • Dynamic Database: open architecture allows for instant addition of new chemical signatures and remote threshold adjustments by authorized personnel.
  • Smart Communication: equipped with LAN, WiFi, and Bluetooth; supports high-speed data export and automatic report printing.
